## Summary

Describe the change and why it is required.

## Governance declaration

- [ ] I read the current `MASTER_RULES.md` before this work.
- [ ] I read `AGENTS.md` and all applicable scoped/vendor rules.
- [ ] I used approved authoritative sources for vendor-specific technical behavior.
- [ ] I did not introduce unverified vendor commands, parameters, defaults, dependencies, or safety claims.
- [ ] Required dependency/conflict/security validation is present or explicitly not applicable.
- [ ] Required tests were executed.
- [ ] Risky changes include verification and rollback strategy.
- [ ] Sensitive values are absent from repository content and sanitized evidence.

## Evidence

List tests, CI runs, vendor knowledge references/digests, and relevant device/lab evidence.
